usage: Screenshot is used as a noun to refer to an image capture of what is currently on a screen.
It functions as a countable noun, so you can say 'one screenshot' or 'two screenshots'.
You can use it as the subject or object of a sentence, e.g. 'This screenshot is clear' or 'I took a screenshot'.
It commonly appears with verbs like 'take', 'send', 'save', and 'share'.
Often, 'screenshot' is used in informal spoken Cantonese when talking about phone or computer activities.
